captured_from: code.claude.com/docs/en/hooks (markdown source, read raw 2026-09-26): "In addition to the common input fields, SessionStart hooks receive `source` and optionally `model`, `agent_type`, and `session_title`", with `source` documented as "`"startup"` for new sessions, `"resume"` for resumed sessions, `"clear"` after `/clear`, `"compact"` after compaction, or `"fork"`". The common fields (`session_id`, `transcript_path`, `cwd`, `hook_event_name`) and their identity shape are the ones session-start-claude.json already carries. Codex documents the same `source: "compact"` discriminator for its SessionStart (codex hooks reference, read 2026-09-26). Every value is neutral synthetic.

placeholders.{{TRANSCRIPT_PATH}}: absolute path of the session transcript
placeholders.{{PROJECT_DIR}}: absolute path of the project whose .planning/ tree the hook reads

notes: The optional `model`, `agent_type` and `session_title` fields are omitted: pan-state-reinject.js reads only `source` and `cwd`. The e2e driver flips `source` to "startup" on the same fixture to prove the hook is inert on every other start.
